record.field: Top reason for which people opt-out from lists

Look at the records of the mailing subscription (model_name: mailing.subscription). Group them by the opt out reason (field_name: opt_out_reason_id). Ignore the "Not specified" or False values, those people did not provide feedback. Answer with the top 3 reasons for which people unsubscribe. The answer should be a numbered list with the total for each reason between parenthesis. Example: 1. I'm not interested (64) 2. I receive too many emails (52) 3. I changed my mind (17) After this list, offer to help me reduce it by giving me marketing techniques. Don't mention the model_name or field_name or any record ids in the response.
